Unstructured In, Structured Out

Payment successful but account still locked
Hello Support Team, I made the payment yesterday, but my account is still locked. I urgently need access to my account. Please resolve this as soon as possible.

THE ARCHITECTURE

Overall Data Transformation

From raw email to structured support information and an automated response.
UNDER THE HOOD

Four Tools, One Workflow

Gmail
Receives customer emails and sends the automated reply.
Zapier
Triggers on new mail, extracts fields, and routes data between every step.
Gemini / LLM
Classifies, scores sentiment and priority, summarizes, and drafts the reply.
Google Sheets
Logs every processed email as a searchable, trackable support record.
THE PITCH
"It converts an unstructured customer email into structured support information and an automated response — using AI and workflow automation."
